segments.en: Today I practise 计算机英语 in a real work conversation. The situation is simple: I need to talk about 钓鱼、恶意软件与安全更新 with a teammate. I use phishing to talk about 网络钓鱼，用假消息诱骗用户交出敏感信息. I use malware to talk about 恶意软件，故意破坏或窃取数据的软件. I use security patch to talk about 安全补丁，修复软件安全漏洞的更新. I tell my teammate: Today I use phishing, malware, and security patch. At the end, I say: I can use phishing clearly today.

segments.en: Today I practise 日常交流英语 in a real work conversation. The situation is simple: I need to talk about 银行和支付 with a teammate. I use I'd like to transfer money. to talk about 我想转账。. I use Has the payment gone through? to talk about 付款成功了吗？. I use I don't recognize this charge. to talk about 我不认识这笔扣款。. I tell my teammate: Today I use I'd like to transfer money., Has the payment gone through?, and I don't recognize this charge.. At the end, I say: I can use I'd like to transfer money. clearly today.
